title: The Roaring Fist of Cianwood
party_selection_rule: 5 vs 5 Party Selection (select 5 Pokémon from active party at battle start)
overview: Cianwood Gym Leader Chuck trains under the roaring waterfall north of Boon Island. Chuck commands heavyweight Fighting hybrids with high physical power and elemental coverage. Kabutops/Machamp leads with 125 Attack, but suffers 2x weaknesses to Grass, Psychic, Ground, and Fairy. Blaziken/Wailord pairs 110 HP with Close Combat and Blaze Kick, weak to Electric, Ground, and Rock. Poliwrath/Primeape wields Belly Drum and Close Combat, crippled by Flying, Psychic, and Fairy. Lucario/Flygon is a speedy special sweeper with Wise Glasses, carrying a fatal 4x Fairy weakness alongside Flying and Psychic. Hitmonchan/Snorlax stacks 110 Sp. Def and Leftovers with Counter, but folds to sustained Flying and Psychic attacks. Victory awards the Storm Badge, Eyebrows & Stache hat, and the Navel Ticket to Navel Rock.

roster.tactics: Physical lead with 125 base Attack. Dynamic Punch hits hard but has 50% accuracy. Battle Armor blocks criticals. Exploit extensive weaknesses to Grass, Psychic, Ground, and Fairy.
Fire/Water tank with 110 HP. Uses Taunt to shut down recovery and strikes with recoil moves. Punish its low 53 Defense with Electric, Ground, or Rock attacks.
Dangerous setup threat with Belly Drum. Damp stops self-destructs. Blast it with Flying, Psychic, Electric, or Fairy attacks before it sets up.
Fast 96 Speed mixed sweeper with Wise Glasses. Carries a fatal 4x Fairy weakness; Fairy moves OHKO instantly. Flying, Psychic, and Ice also hit hard.
Massive 110 Sp. Def anchor with Leftovers. Beware physical Counter. Target its lower 69 physical Defense with Flying, Psychic, or Fighting STAB while avoiding Counter.

starter_strategies.bulbasaur: Venusaur/Charizard (Lv. 72) leads with Sleep Powder to disable threats and fires STAB Petal Dance at Kabutops/Machamp. Alakazam/Weezing (Lv. 71) is immune to Earth Power via Levitate; its 118 SpA STAB Psychic shreds the Fighting roster for clean OHKOs. Gyarados/Arbok (Lv. 71) blunts physical strikes with Intimidate and lands 100% accurate Glare paralysis. Lapras (Lv. 71) provides Water Absorb and Ice Beam, while Kingler/Primeape (Lv. 71) breaks Hitmonchan/Snorlax with Close Combat.
starter_strategies.charmander: Alakazam/Raichu (Lv. 71) sweeps: 120 SpA STAB Psychic deletes Kabutops/Machamp, Poliwrath/Primeape, and Hitmonchan/Snorlax, while Thunderbolt fries Blaziken/Wailord. Charizard/Venusaur (Lv. 72) sleeps dangerous setup sweepers and attacks with Air Slash and Petal Dance. Gyarados/Nidoking (Lv. 71) cuts Chuck's Attack with Intimidate. Lapras (Lv. 71) walls Water with Water Absorb, while Primeape/Sandslash (Lv. 71) wallbreaks with Close Combat and Earthquake.
starter_strategies.squirtle: Blastoise/Fearow (Lv. 72) hard-counters Chuck: its Flying type resists Fighting while STAB Drill Peck carves through the team and Hydro Pump douses Blaziken/Wailord. Jolteon/Sandslash (Lv. 71) zaps Wailord and Poliwrath with Discharge and hits Kabutops with Earthquake. Alakazam/Weezing (Lv. 71) floats over Ground with Levitate and sweeps with STAB Psychic. Arbok/Primeape (Lv. 71) applies Intimidate and Glare paralysis.
